derivation: from G4314 (πρός) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);
def: to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join

occurrences.text: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
